Main article: [Melanoma](/wiki/Melanoma "Melanoma")

Results from the European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and nutrition (EPIC) cohort indicated a positive association between alcohol consumption and skin cancer. Baseline alcohol intake as well as lifetime alcohol consumption were associated with an increased risk of the development of squamous cell carcinoma, basal cell carcinoma, and melanoma in men. There was also an increased risk of these skin cancers in women, but the association wasn't as strong as that seen in men.[[89]](#cite_note-89) Any alcohol intake is associated with the development of [melanoma](/wiki/Melanoma "Melanoma").[[90]](#cite_note-90)

On May 8, 2024, [Nikola Jokić](/wiki/Nikola_Joki%C4%87 "Nikola Jokić") won his third [Most Valuable Player Award](/wiki/NBA_Most_Valuable_Player_Award "NBA Most Valuable Player Award"), becoming the ninth player to do so and tying with other greats such as [Moses Malone](/wiki/Moses_Malone "Moses Malone") and [Larry Bird](/wiki/Larry_Bird "Larry Bird"). The Nuggets faced the [Los Angeles Lakers](/wiki/Los_Angeles_Lakers "Los Angeles Lakers") in the first round and defeated them in five games. In the series, [Jamal Murray](/wiki/Jamal_Murray "Jamal Murray") finished the Lakers with a game-winning buzzer-beater over [Anthony Davis](/wiki/Anthony_Davis "Anthony Davis") to complete a 20-point comeback in Game 2, and later hit another game-winner in Game 5 to eliminate the Lakers. Next, they faced the [Minnesota Timberwolves](/wiki/Minnesota_Timberwolves "Minnesota Timberwolves") in the second round. Along the way, Murray hit a half-court shot in Game 4 to end halftime and stared at *[NBA on TNT](/wiki/NBA_on_TNT "NBA on TNT")* announcer [Kevin Harlan](/wiki/Kevin_Harlan "Kevin Harlan"). The Nuggets ultimately blew a 20-point lead in Game 7 and lost to the Timberwolves.[[92]](#cite_note-92)

St Andrews was founded in 1413 when the [Avignon](/wiki/Avignon_Pope "Avignon Pope") [Antipope Benedict XIII](/wiki/Antipope_Benedict_XIII "Antipope Benedict XIII") issued a [papal bull](/wiki/Papal_bull "Papal bull") to a small founding group of [Augustinian](/wiki/Augustinians "Augustinians") clergy. Along with the universities of [Glasgow](/wiki/University_of_Glasgow "University of Glasgow"), [Aberdeen](/wiki/University_of_Aberdeen "University of Aberdeen"), and [Edinburgh](/wiki/University_of_Edinburgh "University of Edinburgh"), St Andrews was part of the [Scottish Enlightenment](/wiki/Scottish_Enlightenment "Scottish Enlightenment") during the 18th century.
